# Original Kettlebell

> > Manufacturer of American-made and UK-made cast iron kettlebells with Cerakote and E-Coat finishes, featuring comprehensive exercise tutorials and strength training guides.

Original Kettlebell produces premium cast iron kettlebells in both Ohio (USA) and the UK, with separate product lines for each market. The site features extensive workout tutorials by trainers Sam Franklin and Luke Baden, along with buying guides for selecting appropriate weights based on fitness level.

## Key Topics

- Cast Iron Kettlebells
- Cerakote Finish
- E-Coat Finish
- UK-Made Equipment
- USA-Made Equipment (Ohio)
- Sam Franklin (Trainer)
- Luke Baden (Master Trainer)
- Kettlebell Technique
- Strength Training
- Full-Body Workout
- Home Gym Equipment
- Adjustable Dumbbells
- Squat Racks
- ASTM B117 & D4060 Standards
- Kettlebell Weight Selection
